author: blu
body: Proves the solver's statistical judgement. A matchup verdict is only as good as its sample: matchup-stats plays many best-of-three matches and records the wins/losses/draws, and is-significant flags a result as real only when the win margin clears roughly two standard deviations of a fair coin over that sample (margin squared > 4 * total). A survivor is a genome that wins significantly -- not a deck that happened to take one lucky match. This demo checks the judgement on hand-built records so the arithmetic is exact; the real gauntlet feeds these same functions from actual games via matchup-stats / all-wins-rigorous.
